ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_log_ratio_softplus_advantage_exp_agg_clip
ir.intuition: Inject a clipping constraint on the scaled log-probability ratio to stabilize large magnitude values before applying softplus, preventing exploding gradients and improving numeric stability while keeping exponential weighting of the advantage gap.
ir.pseudocode:
ratio = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
scale_factor = exp(advantage_gap)
scaled_ratio = ratio * scale_factor
clipped_ratio = clamp(scaled_ratio, -10, 10)
loss = softplus(-clipped_ratio) * weight
final_loss = mean(loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    ratio = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    scale_factor = ops.exp(adv_gap)
    scaled_ratio = ops.mul(ratio, scale_factor)
    clipped_ratio = ops.clamp(scaled_ratio, -10.0, 10.0)
    loss = ops.softplus(ops.neg(clipped_ratio))
    if weight is not None:
        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    return ops.mean(loss)
